d: Chinese President Xi Jinping has been given a true American airpower welcome during his three-day official visit to Washington, DC. Upon landing, two B-1 bombers flew over Xi. The next day, a B-2 stealth bomber flanked by F-22 stealth fighter jets flew over the White House. On the 24th of September, the B-21 Raider was also spotted carrying out an unannounced flight in Palmdale, California. The B-21 is America's sixth-generation long-range stealth bomber.
